guides.intro: What a Demonology warlock presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. Demonology levels behind its demon: the Voidwalker (from 10) holds the mob, your dots and the demon's talents do the damage, and the wand fills every gap. From 27, **Searing Pain** brands the mob so the Voidwalker's hits deal extra damage. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Immolate, Shadow Bolt and the Imp
stages.change: **Immolate**, a **Shadow Bolt** while your mana is nearly full, then the wand, while the Imp throws **Firebolt**.
press: Send the Imp in, then **Immolate** the mob.
**Shadow Bolt** while you have more than 80% of your mana: about one per mob.
Your wand for the rest.
notes: **Summon Imp** (1) before the first pull: its **Firebolt** casts by itself. Keep **Demon Skin** up at all times, from here to 20.
The fight lab gives you a wand from level 1. Buy one as soon as you can: until then **Shadow Bolt** is the filler too.

stages.title: Corruption, the pull
stages.change: **Corruption** is your pull. From here the dots and the wand do the work, and **Shadow Bolt** waits for a nearly full mana bar.
press: **Corruption** to pull (Mouse 4: the macro sends your demon too), on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies. **Shadow Bolt** only above 80% of your mana.
notes: **Life Tap** (6): between fights, turn health into mana until you have about 70% of your mana, while your health stays above 60%. The next pull then starts with mana, and you rest the health back.
**Curse of Weakness** (4) is not part of the list.

stages.title: Bane of Agony, and Fear while the Imp cannot tank
stages.change: **Bane of Agony** joins **Corruption**. **Fear** what reaches you: the Imp cannot hold a mob.
press: **Corruption** to pull, then **Bane of Agony**, each on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
**Fear** the mob when it reaches you, and wand it while it runs.
Your wand until the mob dies.
notes: The fight lab casts **Fear** about once a mob at these levels: the Imp's **Firebolt** deals damage but holds nothing. The Voidwalker arrives at 10.

stages.title: The Voidwalker tanks
stages.change: **Summon Voidwalker**: it holds the mob while you dot and wand. Talent points start.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Fear** it and wand it while it runs, until the Voidwalker takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Summon Voidwalker** costs a Soul Shard: **Drain Soul** (10) a mob as it dies to get one (Shift+Mouse 4). The fight lab does not count shards; keep two or three in your bags for the demon and your Healthstone.
Heal the Voidwalker between fights with **Consume Shadows** (18, its own spell, not usable in a fight) or **Health Funnel** (12). Check that its **Torment** is on autocast on the pet bar.
**Shadow Bolt** waits for 80% of your mana from here on. With the dots and the wand you rarely have that much past the first pull after a rest, so the fight lab casts almost none.
**Drain Life** (14) goes on R: from 27 it is the answer after **Fear**.

**Unholy Power** (10-14) adds 10% to the Voidwalker's damage, **Demonic Energies** (15, 19) heals it for 15% of your spell damage and **Improved Voidwalker** (16-18) makes **Torment** and **Consume Shadows** 30% stronger. **Improved Imp** (20-21) and **Improved Sayaad** (24) do nothing for a Voidwalker; **Demonic Aegis** (22-23) makes **Demon Armor** 30% stronger.
**Demon Armor** (20) replaces **Demon Skin**. **Rain of Fire** (20) is for packs: one mob at a time never needs it. **Searing Pain** (18) waits for **Demonic Brand** at 27.

stages.title: Demonic Brand: Searing Pain for the Voidwalker
stages.change: **Demonic Brand** (talent): **Searing Pain** brands the mob, and the Voidwalker's next 2 attacks (4 at 28, 6 from 29) deal 65 to 68 extra damage each.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana: rare from here, since the brand costs mana.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs, until the Voidwalker takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Soul Link** (30): click it once after every summon. 30% of the damage you take goes to the Voidwalker, and you both deal 3% more.
**Demonic Knowledge** (31-33) adds spell damage and **Master Demonologist** (38-41) cuts the physical damage you take, both only while the Voidwalker is out: never fight without it.
**Demonic Sacrifice** (25) is only the step to **Soul Link**: never sacrifice your tank.
**Searing Pain** is no finisher here: the tuned rules cast it only on a mob above a third of its health. **Banish** (28) holds a second mob if it is a demon or an elemental.

stages.title: Death Coil; a faster Corruption
stages.change: **Death Coil** for a mob that reaches you while you are hurt. **Improved Corruption** (35-37, 42) shortens **Corruption** to 0.4 seconds; its last rank (58) makes it instant.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana, which the brand almost never leaves you: the fight lab casts it on about one mob in twenty from here.
**Howl of Terror** (40) fears every mob near you: the escape from a pull that brings friends (Shift+F).
**Improved Life Tap** (43-44) adds 20% to each **Life Tap**; **Suppression** (45-48) gives 5% hit and cuts your threat by 20%; **Grim Reach** (49) only widens the range of your Affliction spells.

stages.title: Amplify Curse
stages.change: **Amplify Curse** (talent) makes the next **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger, every 3 minutes. One macro casts both.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** with key 1's macro (it adds Amplify Curse when that is ready), on a mob above about a third of its health.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Amplify Curse** (50): the next **Bane of Agony** is 50% stronger, every 3 minutes. It is off the global cooldown, so the macro on key 1 casts it and the bane in one press when it is ready, and the plain bane otherwise.

**Improved Bane of Agony** (51-52), **Pandemic** (53-54, 59) and **Malevolence** (55-57) make your dots hit harder and crit more often and harder. **Improved Corruption** (58) makes **Corruption** instant.

stages.title: Siphon Life
stages.change: **Siphon Life** (talent): a third dot that heals you.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** (key 1's macro) and **Siphon Life** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: The third dot costs mana: the fight lab casts **Life Tap** in about one fight in three at 60.

between: **Life Tap** back to about 70% mana while your health stays above 60%. Your health comes back while you rest, and the Voidwalker takes the next mob.
Eat only below 55% of your health. Drink only below 15% of your mana, when you are too hurt to **Life Tap**: the fight lab needs almost no drinking.
Heal a Voidwalker below 60% of its health with **Consume Shadows** (not usable in a fight), or with **Health Funnel** when it is below half.
Keep two or three Soul Shards: **Drain Soul** a dying mob for one. **Summon Voidwalker** and **Create Healthstone** use one each, and a new Voidwalker costs one when the old one dies.
Visit the trainer every even level for new ranks of your dots.
other: Affliction and Destruction level with lists of their own: their guides are in this folder, and the leveling index ranks the specs by time per kill.
The Affliction/Demonology hybrid plays this same Demonology list with other talents: its guide is in this folder too.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; armor, summons, Soul Link, conjured stones, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q your bolt, E the control, R the payoff after it, F the save, the thumb buttons the reactions and the pull, 1-4 the rest, the middle mouse button the wand. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup and macros: the [warlock keybinds page](keybinds.md), written for this guide.

slots.role: The payoff after Fear: drain the mob while it runs; your heal
The save: a horror and a heal in one press
Thumb: the brand, each time it drops
Thumb: the pull, with your demon
Mana: in a fight when short, and between fights

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift (a second mob, the pet, packs)

slots.role: Control a second mob, a demon or an elemental
Escape from a pack: fear every mob near you
Finish a mob for a Soul Shard
Free (a healing potion: the macro page)
Free (a mana potion: the macro page)

notes: Q keeps **Shadow Bolt** in every warlock spec. Demonology casts it only above 80% of its mana, mostly on the first pull after a rest: from level 4 the wand on the middle mouse button is your most-pressed key.
Mouse 4 starts every fight from level 4: a macro that sends your demon and casts **Corruption** (the keybinds page). At 1-3, send the Imp from the pet bar and open with **Immolate** on 2.
E then R answers a mob that reaches you: **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. From 42 **Death Coil** on F comes first when you are below 60% health.
Mouse 5 holds **Searing Pain** from 27: press it each time the brand drops. Key 1 becomes the Amplify Curse macro at 50.

No key: **Demon Skin** and **Demon Armor**, **Summon Imp** and **Summon Voidwalker**, **Soul Link**, **Create Healthstone**, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone. Put them on a side bar and click them between fights. The Voidwalker's **Torment** casts by itself; **Consume Shadows** and **Sacrifice** stay on the pet bar.
Every warlock guide in this folder keeps these keys for the spells it shares with Demonology, so the keys feel the same whichever spec you level; each guide's notes name the few keys it changes.

notes: **Summon Voidwalker** costs a Soul Shard: **Drain Soul** (10) a mob as it dies to get one (Shift+Mouse 4). The fight lab does not count shards; keep two or three in your bags for the demon and your Healthstone.
Heal the Voidwalker between fights with **Consume Shadows** (18, its own spell, not usable in a fight) or **Health Funnel** (12). Check that its **Torment** is on autocast on the pet bar.

**Bane** (10-14) takes 0.5 seconds off **Shadow Bolt** and **Immolate**, **Destructive Reach** (15-16) adds 20% to the range of your Destruction spells (start the pull a little farther out), **Cataclysm** (17-19) makes your Destruction spells 10% cheaper, **Ruin** (20-24) doubles their critical strike bonus and **Agonizing Flames** (25-27) adds 10% to their damage. **Intensity** (28-30): your Destruction spells keep their cast time 70% of the time when a mob hits you.
**Drain Life** (14) and **Searing Pain** (18) are not part of this list: the tuned rules measured faster kills without them.
**Demon Armor** (20) replaces **Demon Skin**. **Rain of Fire** (20) is for packs: one mob at a time never needs it.

stages.title: Shadowburn
stages.change: **Shadowburn** (talent) finishes a mob instantly. Cast it only when it will kill: the Soul Shard comes back.
press: **Shadowburn** on a mob it would kill.

Send the Voidwalker in and open with **Shadow Bolt** (Mouse 4's macro) while its **Torment** takes the mob, then **Immolate** on a mob above 30% of its health, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.
**Shadow Bolt** while the mob has more than about a third of its health and you keep a little mana in reserve; below that, your wand.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Shadowburn** if it would kill, otherwise wand it until the Voidwalker's taunt takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Shadowburn** costs a Soul Shard and gives it back when the mob dies within 8 seconds, so a killing **Shadowburn** is free.

stages.title: Conflagrate
stages.change: **Conflagrate** (talent): an instant hit on a burning mob every 10 seconds. Until 39 it uses up your **Immolate**.
press: **Shadowburn** on a mob it would kill.

Send the Voidwalker in and open with **Shadow Bolt** (Mouse 4's macro) while its **Torment** takes the mob, then **Immolate** on a mob above 30% of its health, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.
**Conflagrate** (R) on a burning mob above a fifth of its health, when **Immolate** has about 3 seconds left.
**Shadow Bolt** while the mob has more than about a third of its health and you keep a little mana in reserve; below that, your wand.
**Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Shadowburn** if it would kill, otherwise wand it until the Voidwalker's taunt takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Conflagrate** is no kill shot: the tuned rules cast it only on a mob above a fifth of its health.
**Shadow and Flame** (35-39): at 5 points (39) **Conflagrate** no longer uses up **Immolate**, so cast it whenever it is ready; it also adds 20% to your Shadow damage for 20 seconds.
**Pyroclasm** (33) and **Bane of Havoc** (34) are tier points before **Shadow and Flame**: this list casts no **Soul Fire** and fights one mob at a time, so neither does anything here.

stages.title: Conflagrate on cooldown, the wand on a burning mob
stages.change: **Conflagrate** whenever it is ready. On a burning mob the wand fills between casts; **Shadow Bolt** opens the pull.
press: **Shadowburn** on a mob it would kill.

Send the Voidwalker in and open with **Shadow Bolt** (Mouse 4's macro) while its **Torment** takes the mob, then **Immolate** on a mob above 30% of its health, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.
**Conflagrate** (R) whenever it is ready, on a burning mob above a fifth of its health.
Your wand on a burning mob, between **Conflagrate** casts and to finish it: from 40 the list casts **Shadow Bolt** only before **Immolate** is on the mob.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Shadowburn** if it would kill, **Conflagrate** if it is ready, otherwise wand it until the Voidwalker's taunt takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Incinerate** (40) is a tier point: the tuned rules of 2026-11-07 never cast it, and because the list reserves the filler for it on a burning mob, the fight lab now wands a burning mob instead of casting a bolt: about one and a half **Shadow Bolt** a kill from here, four before. A check on 2026-11-07 (400 fights a level) measured that 5-12% faster per kill at levels 40-60 than bolting the burning mob.
**Fire and Brimstone** (41-43) adds 25% critical strike chance to **Conflagrate**.
**Howl of Terror** (40) fears every mob near you: the escape from a pull that brings friends (Shift+F).

stages.title: Death Coil
stages.change: **Death Coil** for a mob that reaches you while you are hurt. The rest stays.
press: **Shadowburn** on a mob it would kill.

Send the Voidwalker in and open with **Shadow Bolt** (Mouse 4's macro) while its **Torment** takes the mob, then **Immolate** on a mob above 30% of its health, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.
**Conflagrate** whenever it is ready, on a burning mob above a fifth of its health.
Your wand on a burning mob, between **Conflagrate** casts and to finish it: from 40 the list casts **Shadow Bolt** only before **Immolate** is on the mob.
If a mob reaches you below 60% health: **Death Coil** (F), and let the Voidwalker take it back.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Shadowburn** or **Conflagrate** if ready, otherwise wand it until the Voidwalker's taunt takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health: rare from 40, since the wand costs nothing.

**Improved Life Tap** (44) adds 20% to each **Life Tap**. **Suppression** (45-49) gives 5% hit and cuts your threat by 20%, so the Voidwalker keeps the mob. From 50 to 60, **Unholy Power**, **Improved Voidwalker**, **Demonic Energies** and **Fel Vitality** make the Voidwalker hit harder and last longer.

between: **Life Tap** back to about 70% mana while your health stays above 60%. Your health comes back while you rest, and the Voidwalker takes the next mob.
Eat only below 40% of your health (the tuned rule of 2026-11-07). Drink only below 15% of your mana, when you are too hurt to **Life Tap**.
Heal a Voidwalker below 60% of its health with **Consume Shadows** (not usable in a fight), or with **Health Funnel** when it is below half.
Keep two or three Soul Shards: **Drain Soul** a dying mob for one. **Summon Voidwalker** and **Create Healthstone** use one each; a killing **Shadowburn** gives its shard back.
Visit the trainer every even level for new ranks of **Shadow Bolt** and **Immolate**.
other: Demonology and Affliction level with lists of their own: their guides are in this folder, and the leveling index ranks the specs by time per kill.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; armor, summons, Soul Link, conjured stones, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q your bolt, E the control, R the payoff after it, F the save, the thumb buttons the reactions and the pull, 1-4 the rest, the middle mouse button the wand. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup and macros: the [warlock keybinds page](keybinds.md), written for Demonology; this guide changes the keys its notes name.

notes: Every spell Destruction shares with Demonology keeps its key from the [keybinds page](keybinds.md): Q **Shadow Bolt**, 2 **Immolate**, E **Fear**, F **Death Coil**, 4 **Life Tap**, C the Healthstone, the wand on the middle mouse button.

Mouse 4's pull macro casts **Shadow Bolt** in place of **Corruption** from 10: the fight lab opens with a bolt while the Voidwalker takes the mob, then **Immolate**. Destruction casts no Affliction dots, so 1 and 3 stay free.
R holds **Conflagrate** from 32: the tuned rules never cast **Drain Life**, so Demonology's R is free here. Mouse 5 holds **Shadowburn** from 31, the finisher.
**Fear** keeps E for a pull that brings a second mob. The tuned rules of 2026-11-07 never cast it against one mob.

No key: **Demon Skin** and **Demon Armor**, **Summon Imp** and **Summon Voidwalker**, **Create Healthstone**, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone. Put them on a side bar and click them between fights. The Voidwalker's **Torment** casts by itself; **Consume Shadows** and **Sacrifice** stay on the pet bar.

guides.intro: What the Affliction/Demonology hybrid (27 Affliction and 24 Demonology points) presses from level 1 to 60. It plays the Demonology list: the Voidwalker (from 10) holds the mob, **Demonic Brand** (27) turns **Searing Pain** into extra Voidwalker hits, **Corruption** and **Bane of Agony** tick, and the wand does the rest. The Demonology points come first (levels 10-33) and make the Voidwalker a large share of your damage; the Affliction points (34-60) make your dots stronger. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Immolate, Shadow Bolt and the Imp
stages.change: **Immolate**, a **Shadow Bolt** while your mana is nearly full, then the wand, while the Imp throws **Firebolt**.
press: Send the Imp in, then **Immolate** the mob.
**Shadow Bolt** while you have more than 80% of your mana: about one per mob.
Your wand for the rest.
notes: **Summon Imp** (1) before the first pull: its **Firebolt** casts by itself. Keep **Demon Skin** up at all times, from here to 20.
The fight lab gives you a wand from level 1. Buy one as soon as you can: until then **Shadow Bolt** is the filler too.

stages.title: Corruption, the pull
stages.change: **Corruption** is your pull. From here the dots and the wand do the work, and **Shadow Bolt** waits for a nearly full mana bar.
press: **Corruption** to pull (Mouse 4: the macro sends your demon too), on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies. **Shadow Bolt** only above 80% of your mana.
notes: **Life Tap** (6): between fights, turn health into mana until you have about 70% of your mana, while your health stays above 60%. The next pull then starts with mana, and you rest the health back.
**Curse of Weakness** (4) is not part of the list.

stages.title: Bane of Agony, and Fear while the Imp cannot tank
stages.change: **Bane of Agony** joins **Corruption**. **Fear** what reaches you: the Imp cannot hold a mob.
press: **Corruption** to pull, then **Bane of Agony**, each on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
**Fear** the mob when it reaches you, and wand it while it runs.
Your wand until the mob dies.
notes: The fight lab casts **Fear** about once a mob at these levels: the Imp's **Firebolt** deals damage but holds nothing. The Voidwalker arrives at 10.

stages.title: The Voidwalker tanks
stages.change: **Summon Voidwalker**: it holds the mob while you dot and wand. Talent points start, all for the Voidwalker until 33.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Fear** it and wand it while it runs, until the Voidwalker takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Summon Voidwalker** costs a Soul Shard: **Drain Soul** (10) a mob as it dies to get one (Shift+Mouse 4). The fight lab does not count shards; keep two or three in your bags for the demon and your Healthstone.
Heal the Voidwalker between fights with **Consume Shadows** (18, its own spell, not usable in a fight) or **Health Funnel** (12). Check that its **Torment** is on autocast on the pet bar.
**Shadow Bolt** waits for 80% of your mana from here on. With the dots and the wand you rarely have that much past the first pull after a rest, so the fight lab casts almost none.
**Drain Life** (14) goes on R: from 27 it is the answer after **Fear**.

**Unholy Power** (10-14) adds 10% to the Voidwalker's damage, **Demonic Energies** (15, 19) heals it for 15% of your spell damage, **Improved Voidwalker** (16-18) makes **Torment** and **Consume Shadows** 30% stronger, **Fel Vitality** (20, 23-24) adds 15% to the Voidwalker's health and mana and to your mana, and **Demonic Embrace** (21-22) adds 6% to your Stamina.
**Demonic Sacrifice** (25) is a step: never sacrifice your tank. **Master Summoner** (26) shortens a new summon.
**Demon Armor** (20) replaces **Demon Skin**. **Rain of Fire** (20) is for packs: one mob at a time never needs it. **Searing Pain** (18) waits for **Demonic Brand** at 27.

stages.title: Demonic Brand: Searing Pain for the Voidwalker
stages.change: **Demonic Brand** (talent): **Searing Pain** brands the mob, and the Voidwalker's next attacks deal extra damage.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than about a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana: rare from here, since the brand costs mana.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs, until the Voidwalker takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Soul Link** (30): click it once after every summon. 30% of the damage you take goes to the Voidwalker, and you both deal 3% more.
**Demonic Knowledge** (31-33) adds spell damage while the Voidwalker is out: never fight without it.

**Improved Life Tap** (34-35) adds 20% to each **Life Tap**, **Suppression** (36, 41-43) gives 5% hit and cuts your threat by 20%, and **Improved Corruption** (37-40, 47) shortens **Corruption**'s cast: it is instant from 47.
**Searing Pain** is no finisher here: the tuned rules cast it only on a mob above about a third of its health. **Banish** (28) holds a second mob if it is a demon or an elemental.

stages.title: Death Coil
stages.change: **Death Coil** for a mob that reaches you while you are hurt. The rest stays.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than about a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana, which the brand almost never leaves you: the fight lab casts it on about one mob in ten from here, or fewer.
**Howl of Terror** (40) fears every mob near you: the escape from a pull that brings friends (Shift+F).

stages.title: Amplify Curse
stages.change: **Amplify Curse** (talent) makes the next **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger, every 3 minutes. One macro casts both.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than about a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** with key 1's macro (it adds Amplify Curse when that is ready), on a mob above about a third of its health.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Amplify Curse** (44): the next **Bane of Agony** is 50% stronger, every 3 minutes. It is off the global cooldown, so the macro on key 1 casts it and the bane in one press when it is ready, and the plain bane otherwise.
**Improved Bane of Agony** (45-46), **Pandemic** (48, 52) and **Malevolence** (49-51, 53) make your dots hit harder and crit more often and harder.

stages.title: Siphon Life
stages.change: **Siphon Life** (talent): a third dot that heals you.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than about a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** (key 1's macro) and **Siphon Life** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: The third dot costs mana: the fight lab casts **Life Tap** in a fight now and then, about once in three fights at 60.
**Pandemic** (55), **Malevolence** (56), **Suppression** (57) and **Shadow Mastery** (59-60) add damage and hit; **Grim Reach** (58) adds 20% to the range of your Affliction spells.

between: **Life Tap** back to about 70% mana while your health stays above 60%. Your health comes back while you rest, and the Voidwalker takes the next mob.
Eat only below 55% of your health. Drink only below 15% of your mana, when you are too hurt to **Life Tap**: the fight lab needs almost no drinking.
Heal a Voidwalker below 60% of its health with **Consume Shadows** (not usable in a fight), or with **Health Funnel** when it is below half.
Keep two or three Soul Shards: **Drain Soul** a dying mob for one. **Summon Voidwalker** and **Create Healthstone** use one each, and a new Voidwalker costs one when the old one dies.
Visit the trainer every even level for new ranks of your dots.
other: This hybrid plays the Demonology list with the Voidwalker's talents first and Affliction's dot talents after. The Demonology and Affliction guides in this folder show the two specs it is made of; the leveling index ranks the specs by time per kill.
